D: A company of Australian and New Zealand soldiers fight outnumbered in a rubber plantation in Vietnam.
P: Serve the main after the concert at Nui Dat.
S: Nui Dat concert night satay skewers
Lemongrass chicken skewers with peanut satay sauce

Chargrilled chicken skewers marinated in lemongrass and turmeric, with a chunky peanut satay sauce, cucumber and lime. Toss 600g diced chicken thigh with 1 chopped lemongrass stalk, 1 tsp turmeric, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp brown sugar and marinate 30 minutes. Thread onto 12 skewers and grill 8 minutes, turning. Simmer 150g crunchy peanut butter, 200ml coconut milk, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp chilli and lime juice for 3 minutes. Serve with cucumber and lime wedges.
Phuoc Tuy prawn rice paper rolls
Fresh rolls of prawn, vermicelli, carrot and cucumber

Fresh rice paper rolls with prawns, vermicelli, mint, coriander and crunchy vegetables, with a nuoc cham dipping sauce. Soak 100g rice vermicelli in hot water for 5 minutes and drain. Halve 12 peeled cooked prawns lengthways. Julienne 1 carrot and 1 cucumber. Dip 12 rice paper sheets one at a time in warm water for a few seconds. Lay prawns, noodles, vegetables, mint and coriander on each and roll tightly. Mix 3 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp water, 1 garlic clove and chilli for dipping.
M: D Company field kitchen beef and beans
Slow-cooked beef, cannellini beans and paprika over buttered rice

Chuck steak slow-cooked with smoky paprika, tomato and beans until tender, served with buttered rice and pickled chilli for a kick. Brown 800g diced chuck in batches in 2 tbsp oil. Add 1 diced onion, 2 garlic cloves and 1 diced capsicum and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 400g tin crushed tomatoes, 400ml beef stock and a drained 400g tin cannellini beans. Cover and simmer 2 hours until tender. Cook 300g rice and stir through 20g butter. Serve with sliced pickled chilli.
W: Dark chocolate cream pots scented with orange

Rich dark chocolate and orange pots topped with whipped cream, candied orange zest and a crumble of shortbread for crunch. Heat 300ml thickened cream with the zest of 1 orange until steaming. Pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate, leave 1 minute and stir until smooth. Stir in 1 tbsp orange juice. Pour into 4 small glasses and chill 2 hours. Simmer thin strips of orange zest in 2 tbsp sugar and 2 tbsp water for 3 minutes. Top the pots with whipped cream, the candied zest and crumbled shortbread.
K: Strong dark-roast coffee with condensed milk over ice

Strong dark-roast coffee dripped over sweetened condensed milk, stirred and poured over ice, the Vietnamese way. Brew 500ml very strong dark-roast coffee, using a Vietnamese phin filter if you have one or a plunger at double strength. Spoon 2 tbsp condensed milk into each of 4 glasses. Pour the hot coffee over and stir until creamy. Fill with ice and stir again until cold.
